Alpine Prism.name: Alpine Prism
Alpine Prism.label: A QUIET PEAK UNDER GLASS
Alpine Prism.shortDescription: A tall glass prism holding a calm alpine scene of preserved moss and a tiny deer. No water, no sunlight, no fuss.
Alpine Prism.description:
Bring the stillness of the mountains to your desk. The Alpine Prism is a tall, hand-assembled glass prism holding a miniature alpine landscape: soft preserved moss, natural textures and a small deer figure standing quietly at its peak.

The moss is preserved, not living, so it stays green and soft without watering, misting or sunlight. Place it on a work desk, bookshelf, bedside table or reception counter and it will look the same months from now as it does the day it arrives.

A thoughtful gift for nature lovers, new homes, housewarmings and anyone who wants a little calm in their space.
features: Looks great in any light, even without windows

Diamond Prism.name: Diamond Prism
Diamond Prism.label: STONE AND MOSS, FACETED
Diamond Prism.shortDescription: A faceted glass prism filled with lush preserved moss and natural stone — a statement centrepiece for desk or shelf.
Diamond Prism.description:
The Diamond Prism is our most striking piece. Its faceted glass catches the light from every angle, framing a lush landscape of preserved moss and natural stone inside.

Built to be a centrepiece, it brings a calm, natural feel to living rooms, offices and studios. Because the moss is preserved, it keeps its colour and softness without water or sunlight — just dust the glass now and then.

A premium gift for weddings, anniversaries, office openings and corporate gifting.
specs: Faceted glass, preserved moss, natural stone

Ganesha's Pod.name: Ganesha's Pod
Ganesha's Pod.label: A GREEN HOME FOR GANESHA
Ganesha's Pod.shortDescription: A Ganesha idol resting in preserved moss under a glass pod. A calm, auspicious, low-care gift for homes and offices.
Ganesha's Pod.description:
Welcome blessings and calm into your space with Ganesha's Pod. A graceful Ganesha idol sits in a bed of soft preserved moss, protected under a clear glass pod.

It needs no water and no sunlight, so it stays beautiful on a pooja shelf, office desk, shop counter or any quiet corner of the home. The glass keeps dust off the idol and the moss.

A meaningful gift for Diwali, Ganesh Chaturthi, griha pravesh, new jobs, new businesses and every auspicious beginning.
features: Perfect for Diwali, Ganesh Chaturthi and housewarmings
specs: Ganesha idol, preserved moss, glass pod
Pooja shelf, office desk, festive gifting

Nature's Dome.name: Nature's Dome
Nature's Dome.label: A TINY FOREST UNDER A DOME
Nature's Dome.shortDescription: A palm-sized forest of preserved moss and bark under a glass dome on a gold base. Small size, big charm.
Nature's Dome.description:
Nature's Dome is a tiny forest you can hold in your hand. Soft preserved moss and natural bark are arranged into a miniature woodland, set on an elegant gold base and covered with a clear glass dome.

Its compact size makes it perfect for work desks, study tables, bedside tables and small shelves. No watering, no sunlight and no maintenance — it simply stays green.

An easy, elegant gift for birthdays, colleagues, teachers and friends.
specs: Glass dome, gold-finish base, preserved moss, bark

Nature's Prism.name: Nature's Prism
Nature's Prism.label: OUR SIGNATURE PRISM
Nature's Prism.shortDescription: Our signature geometric glass prism with layers of preserved moss, bark and stone. A green landscape that never needs care.
Nature's Prism.description:
Nature's Prism is the piece that started it all. A clean geometric glass prism holds carefully layered preserved moss, bark and stone — a complete little landscape that looks alive but asks for nothing.

No watering, no misting and no sunlight needed. It suits modern homes, minimal workspaces and anywhere you want a touch of green without the upkeep of real plants.

Our most-loved gift for housewarmings, birthdays and anyone who loves nature.

Terra GlowPod.name: Terra GlowPod
Terra GlowPod.label: MOSS THAT GLOWS AT NIGHT
Terra GlowPod.shortDescription: A tall glass terrarium with a warm light in the lid, so your moss landscape glows softly after dark. Doubles as a night lamp.
Terra GlowPod.description:
By day, Terra GlowPod is a tall glass terrarium filled with a lush preserved-moss landscape on a dark base. By night, switch on the warm light built into the lid and the whole scene glows softly — a calming night lamp for bedrooms, living rooms and reading corners.

The moss is preserved, so it needs no water and no sunlight. Just switch it on and enjoy.

A standout gift for couples, new homes, anniversaries and anyone who loves cosy lighting.
features: Warm built-in light in the lid
Tall glass design on a dark base
Standout gift for couples and new homes

The Pod.name: The Pod
The Pod.label: SMALL POD, BIG CALM
The Pod.shortDescription: A compact glass pod with preserved moss — the simplest way to bring green to a desk or bedside table.
The Pod.description:
The Pod is our easiest way to add a little green to your day. A compact glass pod filled with soft preserved moss that stays fresh-looking without water, sunlight or care.

It fits anywhere: work desk, bedside table, bookshelf, window sill or reception counter. Pick one up for yourself, or a few as small gifts for friends and colleagues.

A perfect starter terrarium and an affordable gift.
features: Fits on any desk or shelf
Great as a small or bulk gift

Sunlight Lamp.name: Sunlight Lamp
Sunlight Lamp.label: GOLDEN HOUR, ANY HOUR
Sunlight Lamp.shortDescription: A projection lamp that fills your wall with a warm sunset glow. Instant golden-hour mood for photos, bedrooms and chill evenings.
Sunlight Lamp.description:
Bring golden hour indoors. The Sunlight Lamp projects a warm, glowing circle of light onto your wall, giving any room the soft sunset look that's all over social media.

Use it to set a cosy mood in the bedroom, add warmth to the living room, or light up your photos and reels with a dreamy glow. The adjustable head lets you point the light exactly where you want it.

A fun, aesthetic gift for content creators, students and anyone who loves a cosy room.
features: Adjustable head to aim the light
Great for photos, reels and selfies

Matchstick Table Lamp.name: Matchstick Table Lamp
Matchstick Table Lamp.label: STRIKE UP SOME LIGHT
Matchstick Table Lamp.shortDescription: A playful table lamp shaped like a giant matchstick. A fun conversation piece for desks, shelves and bedside tables.
Matchstick Table Lamp.description:
A playful table lamp shaped like a giant matchstick, with a glowing tip that gives off a warm light. It looks like a design-store piece and makes a fun conversation starter on any desk, shelf or bedside table.

A quirky gift for friends who love unusual home decor.

Cold-Change Soda Cup.name: Cold-Change Soda Cup
Cold-Change Soda Cup.label: POUR COLD, WATCH IT CHANGE
Cold-Change Soda Cup.shortDescription: A 450ml aluminium cup that changes colour when filled with a cold drink. Fun, reusable and made for summer.
Cold-Change Soda Cup.description:
A 450ml aluminium cup that changes colour when you fill it with a cold drink. Pour in soda, juice, iced coffee or water and watch the colour shift.

Lightweight, reusable and fun for parties, summer days and kids' birthdays.

Floral Emoticon Display T-Shirt.name: Floral Emoticon Display T-Shirt

Colour-Changing Sake Cup.name: Colour-Changing Sake Cup
Colour-Changing Sake Cup.label: A JAPANESE CUP WITH A SECRET

A Japanese-style ceramic sake cup that changes colour with the temperature of your drink. Use it for sake, tea or shots and watch the design come alive.

A unique gift for collectors and fans of Japanese design.

GOODBITE Dynamic Display Nautical Stripe.name: GOODBITE Dynamic Display Nautical Stripe T-shirt
GOODBITE Dynamic Display Nautical Stripe.label: CLASSIC STRIPES, LIVE DISPLAY
GOODBITE Dynamic Display Nautical Stripe.shortDescription: A classic nautical stripe tee with a dynamic display on the front. Timeless style with a tech twist.

The GOODBITE Nautical Stripe T-shirt pairs a timeless striped look with a dynamic display on the front. It works as an easy everyday tee, and the display makes it a head-turner at parties, events and college fests.

A fun gift for anyone who loves gadgets and statement fashion.

Glass With Axe.name: Glass With Axe
Glass With Axe.label: POUR LIKE A VIKING
Glass With Axe.shortDescription: A bold drinking glass with an axe design. A rugged showpiece for your bar, desk or shelf.
Glass With Axe.description:
Make every drink feel legendary. This bold glass comes with an axe design that turns an ordinary drink into a rugged, Viking-style moment.

Use it for whisky, juice or cold drinks, or keep it as a showpiece in your home bar. A great gift for brothers, friends, fathers and anyone with a bold style.

Monster Cup.name: Monster Cup
Monster Cup.label: A CUP WITH ATTITUDE
Monster Cup.shortDescription: A playful monster-design cup that makes every drink more fun. Great for kids, gamers and anyone who loves quirky stuff.
Monster Cup.description:
Who said cups have to be boring? The Monster Cup brings a playful monster design to your daily drinks — juice, coffee, milkshake or water.

A fun pick for kids, gamers and anyone who loves quirky things on their desk, and an easy birthday or return gift.

Plant In An Hourglass.name: Plant In An Hourglass
Plant In An Hourglass.label: TIME, GROWING GREEN
Plant In An Hourglass.shortDescription: A little green plant scene inside an hourglass-shaped glass. Calm, minimal decor for desks and shelves.
Plant In An Hourglass.description:
A tiny green scene held inside an elegant hourglass-shaped glass. It's a calm reminder to slow down, and a minimal decor piece that suits desks, study tables and bookshelves.

A thoughtful gift for plant lovers, colleagues and new homes.

RetroBuild – Modular Mechanical Flip Clo.name: RetroBuild – Modular Mechanical Flip Clock

RetroBuild – Modular Mechanical Flip Clo.shortDescription: A modular mechanical flip clock with nostalgic 1990s-inspired design. Satisfying flips, retro style, on your desk.
RetroBuild – Modular Mechanical Flip Clo.description: Bring nostalgic 1990s-inspired design to your desk with RetroBuild, a modular mechanical flip clock. Watch the numbers flip over as time passes — a satisfying retro touch for any workspace.

3D-Printed Monstera Planter.name: 3D-Printed Monstera Planter

Hero Wall Frame with Climbing Figures.name: Hero Wall Frame with Climbing Figures

NFC E-Ink Photo Keychain.name: NFC E-Ink Photo Keychain

Personal gift for couples and friends

Coffee Cup for MoodBoard.name: Coffee Cup for MoodBoard

Coffee Cup for MoodBoard.description:
Complete your MoodBoard setup with this stylish coffee cup. It's made for your daily coffee or tea and looks great in desk setups, flat-lays and content shoots.

A neat add-on gift for anyone who loves an aesthetic workspace.

Wireless charging.name: Wireless Charger
Wireless charging.label: DROP IT, CHARGE IT
Wireless charging.shortDescription: A wireless charger for your phone. Just place it down and it starts charging — no fiddly cables.
Wireless charging.description:
Say goodbye to fiddly cables. Place your phone on this wireless charger and it starts charging straight away. It keeps your desk or bedside table neat and makes topping up as easy as putting your phone down.

Works with phones that support wireless (Qi) charging.

Bike wings.name: Bike Wings
Bike wings.label: RIDE WITH WINGS
Bike wings.shortDescription: Light-up wing projection for your bike that makes you more visible at night — and looks seriously cool.
Bike wings.description:
Give your ride a pair of wings. Bike Wings light up the road beside you with a wing-shaped glow, so cars and other riders can see you clearly at night.

Easy to fit, eye-catching and a fun upgrade for cyclists, riders and night commuters.
features: Makes you more visible at night

Batman Door Beam.name: Batman Door Beam
Batman Door Beam.label: MAKE AN ENTRANCE
Batman Door Beam.shortDescription: A car door light that projects a bat-symbol onto the ground when you open the door. Every exit becomes an entrance.
Batman Door Beam.description:
Step out like a hero. The Batman Door Beam fits on your car door and projects a bat-symbol onto the ground whenever the door opens.

It also lights up the ground so you can see where you're stepping at night. A cool gift for car lovers and superhero fans.
features: Projects a bat-symbol when the door opens
Gift for car lovers and fans

Tail light.name: Tail Light
Tail light.label: BE SEEN FROM BEHIND
Tail light.shortDescription: A bright rear light for your bicycle that keeps you visible to traffic on night rides.
Tail light.description:
Ride safer after dark. This bright tail light fits on the back of your bicycle and makes sure cars and other riders can see you from behind.

Compact, easy to fit and a must-have for night commuters and weekend riders.

Batman Light for Bicycle.name: Batman Light for Bicycle
Batman Light for Bicycle.label: THE BAT-SIGNAL, ON TWO WHEELS
Batman Light for Bicycle.shortDescription: A bicycle light with a bat-symbol design. Light up your ride and look like a hero doing it.
Batman Light for Bicycle.description:
Turn every ride into a hero's patrol. This bicycle light features a bat-symbol design, lighting up your ride while helping others see you on the road.

Easy to fit and a fun gift for kids, teens and superhero fans who love to cycle.
features: Helps you be seen on the road

features: Brew and drink in one cup
